A large '''shipping company''' operated in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] with a site on at least one of the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="WBC" /> Sometime between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] mentions that [[Gen Tiraan]] left the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The book is set three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after that event, noting Tiraan was last reported working for the shipping company. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of Endor to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Tiraan must have joined the company sometime between 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Gen Tiraan]] joined the company after leaving the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], despite having received multiple offers from other companies.<ref name="WBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The shipping company was mentioned in ''[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|Wanted by Cracken]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook authored by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WBC" />
